disagreements.brief_said: Search and by-behaviour dropdown, with no form fields anywhere
disagreements.you_did: Search dialog controlled by keyboard and letter buttons; behaviour menu uses details and buttons
disagreements.why: Keeps search usable by pointer, touch and keyboard without input, textarea, select or editable fields.

disagreements.brief_said: Fully populated scenarios and capability evidence
disagreements.you_did: Aggregate counts displayed exactly; unavailable lower-level evidence labelled as placeholders
disagreements.why: Policy-to-capability mapping and full scenario records are absent from data; no fabricated joins or counts.

disagreements.you_did: Both supplied headlines drawn separately; main homepage preserves Give your AI agent a clear mandate
disagreements.why: Honours the user’s explicitly preferred core headline while presenting the brief’s two studies.

disagreements.you_did: Local interactive vault shell showing supplied counts and source summary
disagreements.why: No external requests are permitted and the live vault data is explicitly missing. The shell is labelled as an example and missing file contents are explicit.

disagreements.you_did: Franklin Gothic / system grotesk stack, alongside Arial and Georgia
disagreements.why: No font asset was supplied. System font study is honest about environment-dependent availability.

disagreements.you_did: All declarations tokenized; media conditions remain 700px and 1050px literals
disagreements.why: CSS custom properties do not resolve inside media query conditions. These two thresholds are named in the manifest; percentages on proportional bars and iframe heights are computed, not visual tokens.

disagreements.you_did: Removed read-not-run badges from audience navigation per the user’s explicit revision
disagreements.why: Audience choices are navigation, not evidence claims.

artwork.audience-strip: Five AI-generated conceptual still lifes; decorative, not portraits or endorsements.
